== March 2, 2006 ==
* Fixed a [[bug]] that caused [[attack skill]]s with non-[[weapon]] attributes to calculate [[damage]] and [[critical hit]] chance incorrectly.
{{clear}}

== September 29, 2005 ==
* [[Pet Attack]]s: each attack functions just like a [[Shout]].
* {{gray|Pet attacks do not have [[activation time]]s and may be activated in the middle of another [[skill]].}}
{{clear}}
